content: धटिका, धटी .²1 Old cloth or raiment. .²2 A strip of cloth fastened round the loins or over the privities. .²3 A kind of garment worn by a woman after Garbhādhāna. .²4 A kind of measure equal to five {%shers%}; द्व्यक्षेन्दुसंख्यैर्धटकैस्तु सैरस्तैः पञ्चभिः स्याद् धटिका च ताभिः <ls>Līlā.</ls>
